intro: Sturdy steel and sleek shutters ensure effortless organisation. A built-in mirror and secure drawer add convenience and safety. Designed for modern homes, the Auraline brings order and style to your home.

features.title: Strong, reliable steel build
features.text: Crafted with premium cold-rolled steel, this almirah stands strong against wear and tear, keeping your belongings safe while lasting for years.

features.title: Safe and secure storage made simple
features.text: The secure drawer is equipped with a 4-digit numeric lock, so you can easily keep your valuables safe without the hassle of managing keys.

features.title: Spacious storage that keeps everything neat
features.text: Thoughtfully designed with shelves and drawers, this almirah ensures your belongings are organised and easily accessible whenever you need them.

features.title: Timeless finish that elevates your room
features.text: The rich textured finish adds a touch of warmth and elegance to your interiors, making this almirah as stylish as it is practical.
